name: Einstein's Workshop Summer Camp
description_short: Week long STEAM camps at Einstein's Workshop in Burlington for kids entering kindergarten through grade 8, with a morning session (9 to 12) and an afternoon session (1 to 4) that can be combined into a full day with supervised lunch.
special_needs_notes: Children with ADHD, autism, anxiety, learning differences or physical needs are welcome. Families are asked to disclose needs at registration and call if the child has an IEP or 504; a child with a one on one aide at school may need a parent or aide to attend.
notes: Prices are per half day camp: $500 for a five day week, $400 for a four day week; a full day is two half day camps. Lunch and Play for half day campers costs $20. Early drop-off from 8:15 and late pick-up to 5:00 or 5:45 (not Fridays) cost extra. Registration for Summer 2027 opens in November 2026.
